en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small stone tower styled like a medieval ruin, with crenellations on top and a cannon‑like tube protruding from the wall. In a niche of the tower stands an armored knight figure with helmet and breastplate beneath a small bell. In front of the tower is an outdoor seating area with a round table covered by a patterned cloth and surrounded by folding chairs. Trees without leaves frame the scene. The word "Raubritterturm" appears in script at the bottom.
